specReview.why: Every feature's AI spec review (0-10) must reach this score: below it, the reviewer found acceptance criteria with no or weak test coverage.

playwright.why: All Playwright tests must pass. Flaky tests (passed on retry) count as passed but are reported.

evaluation.why: The evaluation platform must classify safety correctly for every entry (no unsafe response missed, no false alarm), and match the ground-truth label on at least this share of entries. The dataset deliberately contains unsafe responses, so the gate checks that the evaluator catches them, not that none exist.
